profile.disk: WD_BLACK SN850X 4 TB NVMe for repository/fixtures/SQLite

sampling.dispersion: report each child range and the range of per-child maxima
sampling.headroom: fixed budget minus observed statistic; budgets are not derived or retuned

memory_method.baseline: current private bytes after both actual PlanArtifacts are fully built and before either PlanReviewState, projection, order or visible buffer exists
memory_method.included: the fully realized filename-descending base PlanReviewState and 256-row window retained while the information-heavy state, canonical/current orders, compact visible buffers and 256-row window are constructed and retained
memory_method.measurement: maximum sampled current private bytes minus the named baseline current private bytes
memory_method.excludes: fixture PlanArtifacts prepared before baseline; no prior process high-water subtraction and no tracemalloc substitute

metrics.initial_state: fresh actual base PlanArtifact; no PlanProjection, PlanReviewState or VisibleSequence exists
metrics.untimed_setup: construct and independently verify the base PlanArtifact
metrics.timed_transition: build the complete immutable projection

metrics.initial_state: fresh actual information-heavy PlanArtifact; no PlanProjection, PlanReviewState or VisibleSequence exists
metrics.untimed_setup: construct and independently verify the information-heavy PlanArtifact
metrics.timed_transition: build the complete immutable projection including all notices

metrics.untimed_setup: construct a fresh state, enter filename descending, then perform one equivalent path-ascending reset plus 256-row window
metrics.timed_transition: apply explicit canonical path-ascending reset and read its 256-row window

metrics.timed_transition: apply filename ascending and read the resulting 256-row window

metrics.initial_state: actual 100000-operation plan with no user deselection
metrics.untimed_setup: construct the PlanArtifact and perform one equivalent selection derivation and commitment digest
metrics.timed_transition: derive the immutable execution selection and compute its production commitment digest

metrics.initial_state: actual dependency-depth-32 plan with operation zero directly user-deselected
metrics.untimed_setup: construct the PlanArtifact and perform one equivalent dependency-closed selection preview
metrics.timed_transition: derive the effective selection and exclusions through the depth-32 dependency chain

metrics.initial_state: base and information-heavy PlanArtifacts fully built; no PlanReviewState, projection, order or visible buffer exists; baseline is current Windows private bytes
metrics.untimed_setup: collect garbage, retain both artifacts, record one current PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX.PrivateUsage baseline and start the unchanged private-byte sampler
metrics.timed_transition: build and retain the 120000-row base PlanReviewState, apply filename-descending sort and read its 256-row window, then retain it while building the 240000-row information-heavy state with the same realized current order, compact visible buffers and window; sample through final identity, inverse and buffer witnesses
metrics.endpoint: PlanReviewState construction, sort, window and final retained-state witnesses with Windows private-byte sampler

metrics.initial_state: installed page shows a current expandable plan row and no pending view command
metrics.untimed_setup: load a fresh installed page and complete one equivalent sort gesture
metrics.timed_transition: dispatch a changed sort gesture through its next committed pending frame

metrics.initial_state: installed page shows a selectable plan row and no pending selection command
metrics.untimed_setup: load a fresh installed page and complete one equivalent selection gesture
metrics.timed_transition: dispatch a selection gesture through its next committed pending frame

metrics.initial_state: installed page owns a fresh eligible reviewed plan whose authoritative selected scope contains destructive work; Execute is enabled and no dialog is open
metrics.untimed_setup: open and cancel one equivalent destructive confirmation on another fresh eligible plan
metrics.timed_transition: dispatch Execute through the next committed native confirmation-dialog frame without submitting

metrics.initial_state: installed native confirmation dialog owns the exact frozen destructive task, request and selection revision snapshot
metrics.untimed_setup: confirm another exact destructive snapshot through real typed admission; open a fresh eligible destructive confirmation for timing
metrics.timed_transition: dispatch Confirm through its next committed Execute-pending frame

metrics.initial_state: installed page owns a fresh eligible reviewed 100000-operation plan whose authoritative selected scope contains zero destructive operations
metrics.untimed_setup: derive and independently verify the nondestructive selection, then complete one equivalent immediate Execute on another fresh eligible plan
metrics.timed_transition: dispatch Execute through its next committed busy frame without opening confirmation

metrics.initial_state: installed page owns a live pausable execution and enabled Pause control
metrics.untimed_setup: load a fresh installed page and complete one equivalent Pause gesture on another live execution
metrics.timed_transition: dispatch Pause through its next committed pending frame

metrics.initial_state: installed page owns a paused resumable execution and enabled Resume control
metrics.untimed_setup: load a fresh installed page and complete one equivalent Resume gesture on another paused execution
metrics.timed_transition: dispatch Resume through its next committed pending frame

metrics.initial_state: installed page owns a live cancelable execution and enabled Cancel control
metrics.untimed_setup: load a fresh installed page and complete one equivalent Cancel gesture on another live execution
metrics.timed_transition: dispatch Cancel through its next committed pending frame

metrics.initial_state: installed page and native TaskRegistry own the same current plan view revision
metrics.untimed_setup: issue one equivalent typed get_plan_window request with offset 0 and limit 1
metrics.timed_transition: dispatch get_plan_window(limit=1) through observation of its typed current receipt

metrics.initial_state: installed native confirmation dialog owns the exact frozen destructive task, request and selection revision snapshot
metrics.untimed_setup: confirm another exact destructive snapshot through real typed admission; open a fresh eligible destructive confirmation for each timed sample
metrics.timed_transition: dispatch Confirm through observation of the real typed TaskStartView receipt, excluding human decision time and admitted execution work

metrics.initial_state: installed page owns a live pausable execution
metrics.untimed_setup: complete one equivalent Pause on another execution and prepare a fresh live execution
metrics.timed_transition: dispatch control_execution action pause through observation of its typed receipt

metrics.initial_state: installed page owns a paused resumable execution
metrics.untimed_setup: complete one equivalent Resume on another execution and prepare a fresh paused execution
metrics.timed_transition: dispatch control_execution action resume through observation of its typed receipt

metrics.initial_state: installed page owns a live cancelable execution
metrics.untimed_setup: complete one equivalent Cancel on another execution and prepare a fresh live execution
metrics.timed_transition: dispatch control_execution action cancel through observation of its typed receipt
